T2_STRICT_true_reference.why: the shipped T2 uses the paper MINIMUM as its reference, which makes a DOWN contrast arithmetically impossible (238 up / 0 down / 92 tied over this corpus) and its majority baseline 1.000. This variant scores only papers carrying a TRUE undoped or reference row and uses that row, so the baseline is measured rather than imposed.

T3_within_paper_PDR_sign.verdict: PDR skill CONFOUNDED by base rate — chain accuracy ≈ always-predict-majority; not demonstrated skill

drop_caveat: engine.solve_single runs with strict=True, so a validity failure RAISES. Any dopant listed above was removed from T1's ranking set and from T2/T3's contrast pool; compare n_dopants / n_contrasts against the frozen baseline before reading any statistic.
honest_frame: within-condition contrasts only; pooled absolutes banned (lab confound). T1 (cross-dopant n ranking) is the strongest discriminating test — it probes the donor/acceptor/deep classification directly.
